filo roots
filo roots add DIR [--include-hidden] [--ignore NAME]... [--no-scan]
filo roots set DIR [--include-hidden | --skip-hidden] [--ignore NAME]...

  A root's settings apply to every scan of it, whole or partial.

Flags
  --include-hidden         also scan hidden files and directories (names
                           starting with .)
  --skip-hidden            skip them again (roots set only; the default)
  --ignore NAME            skip entries with this name, at any depth
                           (repeatable); node_modules, __pycache__ and .filo are
                           always skipped
  --no-scan                roots add only: register the root without scanning it

  roots add scans the new root straight away; --no-scan only registers it. roots
  set replaces the whole set, so name every --ignore you want to keep.

  A root that contains existing roots on the same filesystem takes them in,
  keeping their files' history and retentions; its settings then apply to all of
  it. A directory inside an existing root is already covered: scan it with filo
  scan DIR.
